title: Prioritize Vulnerabilities
prompt: For each situation, select the remediation priority: Critical, High, Medium, or Low.

cells: CVSS 9.8, public exploit, no patch available
CVSS 8.1, internal access required, patch available
CVSS 6.5, low-criticality application, no known exploit
CVSS 3.1, isolated system, effective compensating control
CVSS 7.8, unsupported product, lateral movement possible

explain: CVSS severity is only one input: exposure, exploit availability, asset criticality, and compensating controls determine the actual priority. A critically rated flaw on an isolated test bench ranks behind a high-severity flaw on an exposed server.
